name: Blackrock Bounty
summary: In Lakeshire, Blackrock Bounty draws fighters as Blackrock forces gather in northern Redridge. Stormwind sends no royal soldiers, so Magistrate Solomon and Guard Howe offer payment to independent fighters who strike at Blackrock Champions and disrupt the clan’s assault.

sections.title: Holding the Sovereign Line
sections.body: Redridge belongs to the Kingdom of Stormwind, yet the Blackrock clan ignores human borders. Orcs pour through mountain passes from the Burning Steppes and fortify camps across northern Redridge. King Varian Wrynn is missing, and Stormwind’s regency withholds royal soldiers. As Lakeshire’s coffers dwindle, Magistrate Solomon and other local leaders offer bounties to protect the town.

sections.title: Targeting the Champions
sections.body: Guard Howe names the Blackrock Champions as the backbone of the invading vanguard. These squad leaders are battle-hardened veterans who coordinate their warbands and drive lesser grunts forward. Lakeshire’s defenders hope a bounty on the Champions will break the clan’s tactical leadership and stall a full-scale push south. The town’s outer defenses may soon collapse.

faq.q: Why is Guard Howe offering bounties instead of sending the town guard?
faq.answer: Lakeshire’s garrison is stretched thin. Its guards patrol Lake Everstill, protect the bridges, and hold off gnolls and orc raiders. They cannot spare enough fighters to assault the fortified orc camps without leaving the town defenseless.

faq.q: Where are the Blackrock Champions located?
faq.answer: The Blackrock Champions are stationed in the sprawling Blackrock camps in northern Redridge Mountains, just west of the high road that climbs toward the Burning Steppes.

faq.q: Why are the Blackrock orcs invading Redridge?
faq.answer: The Blackrock clan operates from Blackrock Mountain to the north and seeks to conquer and pillage the surrounding hills. With Stormwind’s defense fragmented, the orcs aim to drive out human settlements and claim the mountain passes.

faq.q: Why doesn't Stormwind send royal soldiers to clear them out?
faq.answer: King Varian Wrynn is missing, and the royal court under Regent Bolvar Fordragon and Lady Prestor says the kingdom’s armies cannot be spared. Lakeshire has repeatedly petitioned the capital for help, but its requests are denied. The town is left to hire passing mercenaries.

faq.q: What role do Champions serve within the Blackrock clan?
faq.answer: Blackrock Champions are frontline tactical leaders. They direct attacks, enforce brutal discipline, and lead charges into Alliance territory.
Magistrate Solomon, Lakeshire’s civic leader, authorized the bounty and tasked Guard Howe with recruiting capable fighters to carry out the culling.

angles.text: Lakeshire is Stormwind’s eastern shield. If the Blackrock orcs break through the mountain camps, the Alliance’s core farmlands lie open to invasion.
As a human, you face a clan that destroyed the original Kingdom of Stormwind in the First War. Stopping the Blackrock return south is a bitter ancestral necessity.
As a warrior, you face Blackrock Champions who are heavily armored and seasoned veteran brawlers. Their martial combat tests your discipline and endurance.
